items.title: TIL the BASE in Base Jumping stands for Buildings, Antennas, Spans, and Earth.
items.content_text: submitted by someguy3 to til 19 points | 2 comments BASE is an acronym that stands for four categories of fixed objects from which one can jump: buildings, antennas (referring to radio masts), spans (bridges) and earth (cliffs).[1][2] Participants jump from a fixed object such as a cliff and, after an optional freefall delay, deploy a parachute to slow their descent and land. A popular form of BASE jumping is wingsuit BASE jumping. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BASE_jumping
